sourceNotes.rawContent:
✨ Bigger jar. Bigger surprises. More jewellery to love! 🫙💗
Meet the Premium Mystery Jewellery Jar ₹2,999 by Morchadi Jewels — our ultimate surprise jar created for jewellery lovers who want more pieces, more variety and more excitement in every unboxing.
Each large jar is thoughtfully filled with a premium mix of vintage watches, anti-tarnish jewellery and trendy Korean-style jewellery, giving you 18–20 jewellery & accessory items in every jar.
🎁 What's Inside Every Jar?
Every ₹2,999 Premium Mystery Jar includes:
- ⌚ 2 Vintage Watches – Confirmed in Every Jar
- ✨ 7–8 Anti-Tarnish Jewellery Pieces
- 🌸 9–10 Korean Jewellery Pieces
- 💎 18–20 Total Jewellery & Accessory Items
- 🎀 A beautifully decorated, gift-ready premium jar
The exact designs remain a mystery, making every jar completely unique and exciting to unbox. You may discover necklaces, earrings, bracelets, rings, charms, statement pieces and other trendy jewellery styles.
💕 Why Choose the ₹2,999 Premium Mystery Jar?
✔️ 2 vintage watches guaranteed
✔️ 18–20 total jewellery items
✔️ 7–8 anti-tarnish jewellery pieces
✔️ 9–10 Korean-style jewellery pieces
✔️ Premium & aesthetic presentation
✔️ Huge variety of trendy styles
✔️ Perfect for gifting or treating yourself
✔️ A complete jewellery surprise experience
Whether you're building your jewellery collection, shopping for a special gift or simply LOVE mystery unboxings, this is the jar for you. 🎁✨
More jewellery. More surprises. More joy. 🤍
🎀 Perfect For
Birthday gifts • Anniversary gifts • Best-friend surprises • Self-gifting • Jewellery lovers • Korean jewellery lovers • Vintage watch lovers • Festive gifting
Designs, colours, patterns and styles may vary from the images shown. Each jar is individually curated, so the exact contents remain a surprise. The quantities mentioned above are the guaranteed product categories and approximate item counts.
Please Note : Cash on delivery is not available for this Product
